stem.text: The diagram shows a glycoprotein embedded in the cell surface membrane of a human red blood cell. This glycoprotein is part of a system of cell surface blood group recognition sites.

stem.alt: Glycoprotein drawn as a folded chain with carbohydrate chains marked by crosses, passing through a band labelled cell surface membrane. Labels P and Q point to two regions of the chain.

stem.text: Which row identifies the role of this glycoprotein and regions P and Q of the molecule?
